Over 350 People, and 5 Ways Innovate UK Business Connect Can Support You

After the Innovate UK Business Connect webinar on 19 October 2026: from Petiole Pro in 2017 to MooMore's IP this week, and the five ways the AgriFood team supports startups and growing businesses.

20 October 2026 Understanding the Innovation Journey 📍Online

Over 350 people joined us yesterday for the webinar organised by Innovate UK Business Connect.

I'm sure there are easily ten times more people who are genuinely interested in starting a business in the UK and getting the official business support from the UK Government.

At the webinar, I spoke a bit about how I've been supported since 2017 with Petiole Pro. And now, literally this Friday, I have a meeting with my knowledge transfer partner to talk about intellectual property for MooMore and some other aspects of the founder's journey 🐮

The main point: whether you're a startup or big enough to think about scaling your business, there's a suite of support that fits your needs.

To name a few, here are the 5 ways Innovate UK Business Connect can support you 👇

1. Sector newsletter

Free funding calls, insights and events in your inbox. The team really works hard to collect everything relevant, and I read every issue 🙏

2. Webinars

Free sessions to learn and connect with people in your niche. The next webinar in the series "Understanding the Innovation Journey" is on 8 December, about mentoring.

3. Events

Brokerage events, workshops and the annual AgriFood Innovation Showcase (I've attended most of them!)

4. Sector experts

As I mentioned, a company has a Knowledge Transfer Manager who helps to refine your idea and makes warm introductions.

5. Support as you grow

Help is available at each stage. Whether it's investor readiness, IP rights or the search for university partners for a consortium: explain your innovation and ask.

Where to start?

It takes just a few seconds to sign up for their newsletter.

And as you remember, our rule number one is: missed opportunities never come back 💚
